prompt.project_info: Flash photography snapshot at a hotel rooftop pool at night.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved young adult woman with long loose blonde waves and natural flyaways, glam makeup, relaxed confident gaze, wearing a neutral-toned adjustable string bikini, thin gold waist chain, stacked gold bangles, small stud nose piercing and long white square-tip nails; natural skin texture and stretch marks preserved.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 frame, body angled away at pool edge and partially turned back to camera, one hand near chin/collarbone, infinity pool, stone deck, glass railing, city lights and hotel architecture softly receding behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard direct flash creates crisp facial highlights and natural shadow falloff, dark pool reflections and glamorous candid rooftop-night atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic flash snapshot, 3:4 portrait, sharp face and jewelry, realistic skin texture, controlled night exposure, natural water reflections.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 3:4 photorealistic flash snapshot of one generic approved young adult blonde woman with long loose waves, glam makeup and natural skin texture, standing at a rooftop pool edge at night, body angled away and turned back toward camera, wearing a neutral string bikini, thin gold waist chain, stacked gold bangles, nose stud and white square-tip nails; direct flash, dark pool reflections, glass railing, city lights and hotel architecture behind.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit body-part emphasis, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo overlay

assets.name: rooftop-pool-flash-blonde-goddess.jpg
assets.usage: Match approved adult subject, hair, makeup, swimwear, jewelry, nails, pose, pool, flash and night background.
